ModMetaData.name: Character Editor — Fixes [Star Sky Mods]
ModMetaData.author: chupakobra6 | Star Sky Mods
ModMetaData.description: Restore body-size genes in Character Editor and fix two names in its bundled name file. FEATURES • The body-size gene list uses gene identifiers. Translating gene labels no longer hides those genes in the editor. • Name loading removes an initial byte-order mark and restores the separator before Kai Henriksen. Both names remain available separately. HOW TO USE Enable the mod and open Character Editor. There are no settings: the fixes apply when the editor displays body-size genes and loads names. COMPATIBILITY Requires RimWorld 1.6, Harmony (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2009463077) and Character Editor (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1874644848). Load in this order: Harmony → Character Editor → Character Editor — Fixes. FEEDBACK Found a bug? Leave a comment on the mod page or on Boosty. Original mod by void.
